decisions.reason: The same source message's Android language decision is already fully represented by the existing message 71 MODIFY setting supported_android_languages to all 77 Google Play languages.
Selecting all approximately 40 App Store languages establishes localization coverage but does not necessarily change the existing iOS download-size optimization goal or packaging strategies.
The language-list decision does not change the Android package-size optimization goal or its existing asset and tutorial packaging strategies.
The selected language counts do not alter how tutorial content is delivered or presented; reusable backgrounds and translatable text overlays remain valid unchanged.
